description: Field migrations that bring site content up to the current engine spec. Each entry describes a field whose canonical shape changed but which the engine still renders via a back-compat shim, so existing content never breaks and can be migrated forward when convenient. Published for tooling that checks site content against the engine: an entry lets a renamed field be reported as 'migrate to X' rather than as an unknown field. Add one whenever a field's canonical shape changes AND a shim keeps the old one rendering.

migrations.note: Flat label/href pair folded into the cta { label, link:{url} } group (resolveButton back-compat).
migrations.label: label

migrations.note: Second flat button on ctaBox → the cta2 group.
migrations.label: label2

migrations.note: Header-style blocks used ctaLabel/ctaHref before the cta group.
migrations.label: ctaLabel

migrations.note: FAQ aside button; the href arrived as either asideHref or asideCtaHref.
migrations.label: asideCtaLabel

migrations.note: Fragment's quiet link: the legacy linkLabel/link pair on the block folds into the cta group (resolveButton back-compat). Same pair as featureGrid's, but on the block itself rather than on list items.
migrations.label: linkLabel

migrations.note: featureGrid card link: the legacy linkLabel/link pair on each item folds into the item's cta group (component reads it.cta ?? the legacy pair). `in` = the list field whose items carry the pair.
migrations.label: linkLabel
